dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.a_menu.teach3: Teach me the Peak Crossing gear
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.a_menu.ward3: Reweave the Thunder Wing ward (8 charged cotton)
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch3a_first:
We meet again, traveller. ...The peak wind makes wire sing. Listen to it.
These are notes for the peaks. I wrote down how to handle scorched feathers and charged cotton.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch3a_ward: The ward came undone? You brought the charged cotton. ...There, rewoven. One a day, no more.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch3p_teach:
You want the patterns. ...Scorched feathers are light. Pack charged cotton into the seams and the lightning stays off your skin. Wind copper wire round the hems.
The whetstone, the dumplings and the oil are in the notes. The streamer is for reading the wind.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch3t_ward_weav:
Thunder ward thread. ...It numbs the fingers. A living thread.
I will weave it into a heartbeat ward. When the beat quickens inside the wing, hold it.
item.skyabyss.copper_wire.desc: Thin drawn copper. For hems, whetstones and oil.
item.skyabyss.lightning_oil.desc: Oil with copper dissolved in it. Drink it and shocks and lightning hurt half as much for ninety seconds. Lightning runs to high copper.
item.skyabyss.peak_crossing_armor.desc: Layered scorched feathers with charged cotton in the seams. Lightning rarely reaches the skin (full set: shock damage -25%).
item.skyabyss.peak_crossing_boots.story: "Tap a peak stone once before you trust it."
item.skyabyss.peak_crossing_chestplate.s: "The more singed the feather, the farther it flew."
item.skyabyss.peak_crossing_helmet.story: "Never cover the ears that hear the wind."
item.skyabyss.peak_crossing_leggings.sto: "When the copper hem hums, get down."
item.skyabyss.scorched_feather.desc: A feather singed at the tip by lightning. Light; for travel gear and streamers.
item.skyabyss.static_cotton.desc: Cotton that snaps when touched. Packed into seams, it sheds lightning.
item.skyabyss.thunder_ward_thread.desc: A white thread that numbs the fingers. Material for the Thunder Wing heartbeat ward.
item.skyabyss.thunder_whetstone.desc: Charges your blade for twenty minutes (+2.2 attack). Every hit throws a small spark.
item.skyabyss.wind_dumpling.desc: Dumplings dried in the peak wind. You feel lighter and fall slowly (Absorption II 60 s, Slow Falling 20 s).
item.skyabyss.wind_streamer.desc: Plant it to see a thin line of light run downwind for thirty seconds, and how long until the next storm (once every 30 seconds; never used up).
message.skyabyss.lightning_oil.used: A taste of copper lingers. For ninety seconds lightning slips past you more easily.
message.skyabyss.thunder_whetstone.used: The edge hums thinly. For twenty minutes the lightning stays in it.
message.skyabyss.wind_streamer.now: The wind runs %s. You are in the storm now.
message.skyabyss.wind_streamer.read: The wind runs %s. The next storm is about %s minutes away.
message.skyabyss.wind_streamer.still: The wind runs %s. No storm can be read.
wayfarer_notes.ch3.line.1: A static puff discharges after its fluff stands on end. Stand close together and the spark jumps to your neighbour. When the fluff rises, spread out.
wayfarer_notes.ch3.line.2: A peak fledgling rises, then draws a glowing line on the ground. Step off the line. A fledgling that misses hits the rock and reels.
wayfarer_notes.ch3.line.3: Lightning gleaners only flee. Startle one and it drops its pack. Follow it and you reach the field of burnt cargo.
wayfarer_notes.ch3.line.4: The scorched warden is hard to cut. Let the pillar's lightning strike it and your blade bites for a while. When a ring appears at its feet, get out.
wayfarer_notes.ch3.line.5: Lightning falls on high copper. Do not stand by the pillar. Drink lightning oil and shocks hurt half as much.
wayfarer_notes.ch3.line.6: Plant a wind streamer to learn the wind and how long until the next storm. Read the storm beat on the wing the same way.
wayfarer_notes.ch3.line.7: Scorched feathers, charged cotton and copper wire make travel gear, thunder whetstones, oil and streamers. Open these notes and the recipes appear at the table.
